description.value: Anahim Lake Resort sits on the eastern slope of the Coastal Mountains along BC's Chilcotin Highway (Hwy 20), roughly halfway between Williams Lake and Bella Coola — a natural overnight stop for cyclists riding the Freedom Highway. The resort offers tent sites along the lakeshore, RV hookups with 15 & 30 amp electric and water, and rustic cabins equipped with a wood stove, hot plate, and fridge. Free hot showers and Wi-Fi are included, making it a comfortable base in an otherwise very remote stretch of interior BC.

address.value: 2799 Reed Road, Anahim Lake, BC V0L 1C0

Phone and address match between OSM and the website.
